assertions.assert: Its input is its `<param>`s: it sends itself `bot.ability.vision.detection.input` `{image, media_type}` (the image by reference), which its schema checks, so an `image` that is missing or empty sends nothing to the model and answers `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "ObjectDetection could not run (error.execution)"}`; nothing reaches the parent before its one answer.

It asks the generate service once, with one user message (its instructions, which hold no JSON, as a text part and the image's reference as an image part, the image read from the granted media directory) and the detections tool (decision D201), and answers its parent `bot.ability.vision.detection.output` `{objects}`, each object `{label, confidence, box: {x, y, width, height}}` as the call gave it; a call with no objects is `{objects: []}`; then it ends (`done.invoke.<id>` follows the answer).
The objects of every detections call of the reply are read, in order, as one list.

The detections tool's schema admits an object only as `label` a string of 1..100 characters, `confidence` 0..1 or `null` (required), `box` a box (`x`, `y` in 0..1, `width`, `height` in (0, 1]), its numbers JSON numbers (a boolean or a numeric string is refused), and no other keys; an object whose box passes the image's edge (`x + width` or `y + height` over 1 + 1e-6) is skipped, never failing the detection.
The first `max_objects` (32 by default, a `<param>`) objects, in reply order, are kept, then ordered by descending confidence, unrated last, equally rated objects keeping the reply's order.

Arguments the detections tool's schema refuses (an object it does not admit, or no `objects` array) fail the detection: `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "Object detection generator failed: schema-mismatch."}` (never the arguments themselves), and arguments that are not JSON `{message: "Object detection generator failed: not-json."}`.

A model call that fails answers `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "Object detection generator failed: <code>."}`, the generate service's failure code in the message, and an image reference the generate service cannot read rejects its start: `{message: "ObjectDetection could not run (error.execution)"}`.
An output its schema refuses (more than 32 objects, when the invoker allows more) answers `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "Object detection produced output that does not match its output schema."}`.
